retired_nodes.title: Contas Regionais do Brasil – Unidades da Federação (PIB Estadual)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Annual regional accounts providing Gross Domestic Product, value added by major sectors, and related aggregates for each of the 27 Federation Units (states + DF). Compiled in methodological partnership with state statistical offices under a uniform SNA-consistent framework linked to the national Sistema de Contas Nacionais. Forms the principal official series for inter-state comparison and the bridge from national to state economic activity. Municipal GDP series are produced in the same programme.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de São Paulo (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for the City of São Paulo produced within the IBGE Contas Regionais / PIB dos Municípios programme. São Paulo municipality accounts for approximately 9.7% of Brazilian GDP and roughly one-third of the state of São Paulo’s GDP. Forms the direct vertical link from the municipal to the state and national accounts.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município do Rio de Janeiro (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for the City of Rio de Janeiro within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Second-largest municipal economy in Brazil (≈3.8% of national GDP). Provides the official municipal-to-state vertical bridge for Rio de Janeiro.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Belo Horizonte (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Belo Horizonte within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. One of the ten largest municipal economies in Brazil. Links the capital of Minas Gerais into the state and national accounts hierarchy.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Manaus (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Manaus within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme (in partnership with SUFRAMA for Free Trade Zone activity). Manaus accounts for roughly 80% of Amazonas state GDP and is among the ten largest municipal economies nationally. Provides the Amazon metropolitan contrast node.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Porto Alegre (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Porto Alegre within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Rio Grande do Sul and one of the larger southern municipal economies. Completes the vertical chain from municipal to state (DEE) to national accounts for the southern high-output node.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Curitiba (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Curitiba within the IBGE Contas Regionais / PIB dos Municípios programme. Capital of Paraná and one of the larger southern municipal economies; anchors the vertical chain for the PR state node.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Recife (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Recife within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Pernambuco and principal metropolitan economy of the state; provides the municipal anchor for the PE North-East contrast node.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Florianópolis (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Florianópolis within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Santa Catarina; anchors the vertical chain for the SC state node alongside larger industrial municipalities (Joinville, Itajaí).

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Fortaleza (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Fortaleza within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. Capital of Ceará and principal metropolitan economy of the state; anchors the vertical chain for the CE North-East contrast node.

retired_nodes.title: PIB do Município de Brasília (IBGE Contas Regionais)
retired_nodes.publisher: Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE)
retired_nodes.description: Municipal Gross Domestic Product estimate for Brasília (essentially coincident with the Distrito Federal in statistical practice) within the IBGE Contas Regionais programme. One of the largest municipal economies and the institutional capital node.

live_edges_before.basis: Municipal GDP estimates are produced within the same Contas Regionais programme and share the same conceptual framework, classifications and balancing procedures as the state-level accounts.
The DEE/SPGG of Rio Grande do Sul calculates state and municipal PIB in explicit methodological partnership with IBGE Contas Regionais.
DEE Rio Grande do Sul calculates state and municipal PIB in partnership with IBGE; the Porto Alegre municipal figure is a core input to the state series.
IPARDES calculates the Paraná PIB series in explicit methodological cooperation with the IBGE Contas Regionais programme; state results are reconciled to national totals.
IPEDF is the official IBGE partner for Contas Regionais in the Distrito Federal and produces the DF PIB under that system (plus an independent quarterly series).

FJP's own 'PIB dos Municipios Mineiros 2019' states municipal GDP is calculated by Brazil's Sistema de Contas Regionais, coordinated by IBGE in partnership with state statistical institutes -- naming Fundacao Joao Pinheiro as Minas Gerais's institute -- and the same document discusses Belo Horizonte's specific PIB share in depth.

IPEDF/CODEPLAN's own page states GDP results integrate Brazil's Sistema de Contas Regionais (an IBGE project) and that IPEDF Codeplan is IBGE's official institution for calculating the Federal District's GDP within that system. DF is coterminous with the single 'Brasilia' municipality in IBGE's municipal series.

IPECE's own 'Analise do PIB dos Municipios Cearenses -- 2022/2023' states its Municipal GDP Series 'constitui uma analise dos ultimos resultados disponiveis das Contas Regionais divulgados pelo IBGE' and that municipal GDP calculation is conceptually integrated with Brazil's Regional Accounts System procedures.
live_edges_before.evidence_quote: constitui uma analise dos ultimos resultados disponiveis das Contas Regionais divulgados pelo IBGE

live_edges_before.basis: News coverage of the joint IBGE/SEPLAN-SC municipal-GDP release quotes SEPLAN-SC economist Paulo Zoldan as coordinating 'a apuracao do PIB do Estado e dos municipios em parceria com o IBGE'. Zoldan is independently confirmed as Santa Catarina's named external collaborator in IBGE's own official technical note for this same product (https://biblioteca.ibge.gov.br/visualizacao/livros/liv102250_notas_tecnicas.pdf) -- corroborating a real, direct role rather than a paraphrase.
live_edges_before.evidence_quote: a apuracao do PIB do Estado e dos municipios em parceria com o IBGE

live_edges_before.basis: IBGE's own official technical note for 'Produto Interno Bruto dos Municipios: Brasil: 2022-2023' names IPARDES (Instituto Paranaense de Desenvolvimento Economico e Social) as Parana's external collaborator institute for this product, with two named individual collaborators. IPARDES's own site had no quotable prose specific to the municipal series, so this edge rests on IBGE's own document rather than IPARDES's.

IBGE's own official technical note for 'Produto Interno Bruto dos Municipios: Brasil: 2022-2023' names CEPERJ (Fundacao Centro Estadual de Estatisticas, Pesquisas e Formacao de Servidores Publicos do Rio de Janeiro) as Rio de Janeiro's external collaborator institute for this product, with two named individual collaborators. CEPERJ's own domains were unreachable this round (consistent robots.txt/timeout/403 across 6+ attempts), so this edge rests on IBGE's own document rather than CEPERJ's -- same pattern as an official agency's own page standing in when the primary domain is technically unreachable.
